dataset: Catbalogan City barangays (57) with PSA census population and households

boundaries.source: PSGC 2023 barangay boundaries via faeldon/philippines-json-maps (derived from PSA / NAMRIA)
boundaries.quality: Simplified, approximate boundaries (about 15 vertices per barangay). For display and summary only, not for surveying.

statistics.source: PSA Census of Population 2015, 2020 and 2024 (barangay level), as compiled by the team's Tuklas Catbalogan dashboard
statistics.fields: pop2015, pop2020, pop2024, hh2024 (households), hhsize2024, area_km2_approx and density_approx (computed from the simplified polygons)
statistics.checks: 57 of 57 barangays joined on PSGC code; population 2024 sums to 107,896 (matches the City CBMS dashboard total); population 2020 sums to 106,440 (PSA 2020 census total for Catbalogan). Households 2024 sum to 25,235 (PSA census); the City CBMS dashboard reports 23,880 households (different survey).

notes: Administrative polygons. Never used as a watershed or catchment. The Catbalogan Watershed Forest Reserve also extends into Jiabong, whose barangays are not included.
